description: List the pages open on a Chrome DevTools Protocol endpoint (desktop debug port or an Android phone over adb), with the connection id each would get and whether it is already attached. Use it to reach pages the pwa-debug extension cannot run in: Android Chrome tabs, installed PWAs on a phone, or a desktop browser without the extension. Args: { browser_url }. For an Android phone: forward its DevTools socket first with `adb forward tcp:9223 localabstract:chrome_devtools_remote` (run it yourself if you have a shell, otherwise give the user that command), then use browser_url "9223". To load a desktop dev server on the phone, also run `adb reverse tcp:<port> tcp:<port>` so the phone can open http://localhost:<port>.

browser_url.description: Debug endpoint: a port ('9222'), 'host:port', or an http/ws URL.

name: pdl_cdp_targets
